remarks: Tucked away in Norwalk's desirable Cranbury neighborhood, this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2 full-bath home sits on over 3 picturesque acres complete with a private pond-offering a rare and peaceful setting. The first floor features an updated kitchen with a dining area, opening seamlessly into the family room. Just off the family room is an oversized laundry room with abundant storage. A main-level bedroom and a fully updated bath complete this level. Upstairs, you'll find an additional full bathroom and a spacious second bedroom. The outdoor space is where this home truly shines-relax by the pond, fish, watch wildlife, play in the level yard, or simply enjoy the privacy and open space that make this property feel like a true retreat. A perfect rental for anyone seeking comfort, space, and tranquility, all while being conveniently close to everything Norwalk has to offer. House shares the property with the main house that is rented.
